title: 10 Mid-Cap Stocks Reporting Earnings Next Week That Tickeron's AI Flags as Winners
author: tickeron_community
selftext:
Key takeaways:

* This basket is dominated by biotech: [OGN](https://tickeron.com/ticker/OGN/), [ATAI](https://tickeron.com/ticker/ATAI/), and [FBRX](https://tickeron.com/ticker/FBRX/) are all within 0.5% of their 52-week highs going into earnings.
* [FBRX](https://tickeron.com/ticker/FBRX/) leads the group up **+181.22%** YTD; [OGN](https://tickeron.com/ticker/OGN/) is trading right at its 52-week high.
* [Tickeron's AI Trading Bots](https://tickeron.com/app/ai-robots/trending-robots/) flag every name in this basket as YTD-positive — a cleaner setup than the penny-stock tier below.
* [SBR](https://tickeron.com/ticker/SBR/), the lone royalty trust in the group, offers a lower-beta, income-oriented alternative to the biotech-heavy names around it.
* [PHI](https://tickeron.com/ticker/PHI/) is the outlier — down YTD and further from its high — included as the value/rebound name in an otherwise momentum-heavy basket.

[**OGN**](https://tickeron.com/ticker/OGN/) **— Organon & Co.**  
OGN trades at **$13.72** (+0.15% today) and sits exactly at its 52-week high of $13.72 (low: $5.69), up **+91.35%** YTD. Market cap: $3.60B. Trading right at its yearly high going into earnings makes this Tickeron's top technical setup in the mid-cap tier. **30-day forecast: bullish.**

[**ATAI**](https://tickeron.com/ticker/ATAI/) **— AtaiBeckley Inc.**  
At **$7.26** (+0.14% today), ATAI is up **+77.51%** YTD, just 0.27% below its $7.28 high (low: $3.27). Market cap: $2.69B. The newly combined mental-health biopharma name (formed from the atai Life Sciences/Beckley Psytech merger) is flagged for its tight breakout gap into earnings. **30-day forecast: bullish.**

[**FBRX**](https://tickeron.com/ticker/FBRX/) **— Forte Biosciences, Inc.**  
FBRX is at **$76.83** (-0.04% today), the top YTD performer in this basket at **+181.22%**, just 0.48% off its $77.20 high (low: $10.11). Market cap: $1.57B. One of 2026's biggest biotech re-ratings, still parked at the top of its range into earnings. **30-day forecast: bullish.**

[**JBIO**](https://tickeron.com/ticker/JBIO/) **— Jade Biosciences, Inc.**  
At **$24.71** (+3.78% today, the largest mover in this tier), JBIO is up **+60.14%** YTD, 11.75% below its $28.00 high (low: $6.71). Market cap: $1.50B. A strong pre-earnings pop earns JBIO a spot as the momentum pick in the basket. **30-day forecast: bullish.**

[**SNDA**](https://tickeron.com/ticker/SNDA/) **— Sonida Senior Living, Inc.**  
SNDA trades at **$39.15** (-0.20% today), up **+19.87%** YTD, 11.80% below its $44.39 high (low: $24.65). Market cap: $1.86B. Senior-housing occupancy trends support the steady uptrend into earnings. **30-day forecast: bullish.**

[**SEPN**](https://tickeron.com/ticker/SEPN/) **— Septerna, Inc.**  
At **$44.50** (-1.42% today), SEPN is up **+59.50%** YTD, 12.92% below its $51.10 high (low: $10.74). Market cap: $2.01B. A modest pullback into earnings hasn't dented the year's strong biotech run. **30-day forecast: bullish.**

[**SBR**](https://tickeron.com/ticker/SBR/) **— Sabine Royalty Trust**  
SBR is at **$72.90** (+0.21% today), up a modest **+6.22%** YTD, 13.62% below its $84.39 high (low: $65.31). Market cap: $1.06B. Tickeron's AI includes SBR as the lower-volatility, income-oriented royalty-trust hedge in an otherwise growth-heavy basket. **30-day forecast: bullish, low volatility.**

[**TSHA**](https://tickeron.com/ticker/TSHA/) **— Taysha Gene Therapies, Inc.**  
At **$5.95** (-0.67% today), TSHA is up **+8.38%** YTD, 18.49% below its $7.30 high (low: $2.71). Market cap: $1.90B. Gene-therapy pipeline catalysts into earnings keep this on Tickeron's watch list despite the wider gap to high. **30-day forecast: bullish, higher volatility.**

[**ANAB**](https://tickeron.com/ticker/ANAB/) **— AnaptysBio, Inc.**  
ANAB trades at **$58.47** (+4.37% today, the biggest daily mover in the mid-cap tier), up **+20.48%** YTD, 19.20% below its $72.36 high (low: $11.40). Market cap: $1.73B. The sharp pre-earnings rally is what pushed ANAB into this basket. **30-day forecast: bullish.**

[**PHI**](https://tickeron.com/ticker/PHI/) **— PLDT Inc.**  
At **$19.31** (-0.77% today), PHI is the lone decliner in this basket at **-11.18%** YTD, 21.22% below its $24.51 high (low: $17.05). Market cap: $4.17B. Included as the contrarian value name — the Philippine telecom giant is furthest from its high of the mid-cap group, making it the highest-upside rebound candidate if earnings surprise positively. **30-day forecast: neutral-to-bullish, contingent on guidance.**

[**Tickeron's AI Trading Bots**](https://tickeron.com/app/ai-robots/trending-robots/) **and Financial Learning Models:** This mid-cap basket shows Tickeron's AI Trading Bots rotating heavily into biotech (OGN, ATAI, FBRX, JBIO, SEPN, TSHA, ANAB) — a sector where the bots' 300-million-pattern Pattern Recognition Engine has been especially effective at flagging tight breakout setups like OGN trading at its own 52-week high. Tickeron's Financial Learning Models layer trend-detection on top, distinguishing between names already at highs (OGN) versus names further from their range that carry more rebound-style upside if earnings beat (PHI, TSHA). The lone non-biotech name, SBR, is flagged by the FLMs as a rotation-hedge pick for traders who want earnings-week exposure without full biotech concentration.
